relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis revealed that ADAM17 protein levels were significantly increased in the SDH of the SNL group compared to the sham-operated control group

relationships.subject: ADAM17
relationships.evidence_quote: re-ADAM17 significantly elevated the protein levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 in the spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: Xpro1595
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal administration of Xpro®1595 (10 μg/kg) on day 3 post-SNL significantly attenuated the injury-induced upregulation of ADAM17 protein in the SDH

relationships.subject: Xpro1595
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with Xpro®1595 (10 μg/kg) robustly suppressed this injury-induced surge in all three cytokines

key_findings: ADAM17 is upregulated in rat spinal dorsal horn and DRG after SNL, colocalizing with TRPV1, CGRP and IB4 nociceptors; intrathecal recombinant ADAM17 is sufficient to cause hypersensitivity and raise TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6.
Selective soluble TNF inhibitor Xpro1595 reduced SNL allodynia, ADAM17 upregulation and spinal cytokines, suggesting an ADAM17/solTNF feedback loop.
